at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Validation failures in `ledgerly.invoice` raise `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with codes like `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` and `negative_amount`; reuse these codes instead of inventing new exception types.

at-0004.content: When checking that a quantity is a positive int, guard with `isinstance(quantity, bool)` first because `bool` subclasses `int`; otherwise `True` passes as quantity 1.

at-0007.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check first
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any validation or state change: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry written.
